title: repair/safety/edit heads -- deployable-learning crux (local features predict the R4 beneficial edits)
decision: KEEP -> R6 (PARTIAL POSITIVE; campaign's first decisive deployable-LEARNING positive)

deployable.csi_scope: R5 runs with the stale-CSI POMDP overlay OFF (residual_ppo_train._build passes no csi_observation_model); ef is the CURRENT-frame channel (the deployable channel used across R3/R4). 'no true CSI' here means the head never sees the evaluator/critic/central reliability computation, NOT that the channel is stale (stale-CSI is the separate R1/R2 axis). Stale-CSI survival of the learned ranking is evaluated at R6/R8.

result_5seed.config: train 5 scenes-build, held 10 scenes-build, 4 frames, epochs 40, hidden 64, seeds [0,1,2,3,4]

interpretation: Local-feature heads DECISIVELY learn the R4 beneficial-edit ranking on random (CI entirely >0, 3.2x lift, repair_corr CI>0, untrained control at chance => learning not metric) and IN MEAN on urban (4.5x lift, CI spans 0 by 0.005, not 95%-sig at n=5). This is the deployable-LEARNING question answered POSITIVELY; NOT a learning gap. R5 proves the RANKING is locally learnable, not yet that it improves the deployed topology (R6).
effect_on_decision: heads change the candidate-edit RANKING (held top-k precision +0.25 random / +0.18 urban over random baseline); deployed-topology effect is R6.
scope_boundary: (a) urban 95%-significance at n=5 (CI lo -0.005); (b) random CI lo +0.089 is small (n=5 fragile, single-seed +0.324 vs mean +0.251) -- 'decisive' qualified as 'at n=5'; (c) deployed feasibility/return gain unproven until R6 end-to-end eval; (d) learned on the current-frame channel -- stale-CSI survival deferred to R6/R8. Headline rests on edit precision + repair_corr (CI>0), not safety_corr (spans 0 on random).

adversarial_verification.independent_checks: causal ablation (zeroing edit_head collapses prec-base +0.324->-0.128); train/held seed-disjoint (overlap 0); CI arithmetic reconstructs exactly (t=2.776, 4 dof); untrained control at chance both regimes.
adversarial_verification.minor_fixes_applied: (1) clarified 'no true CSI' = no evaluator/critic/central computation; ef is current-frame channel (stale overlay off); (2) qualified 'decisive' as at n=5, headline on repair_corr not safety_corr; (3) acceptance gate stated per-regime.
